tools.name: choose_ferry_slip
tools.description: Asks which Port Townsend ferry slip the Chetzemoka should take

slip.message: Which Port Townsend ferry slip should the Chetzemoka take?

results.A: Chetzemoka takes slip A. Wind 18 kn off Point Hudson. Hold the outbound until the flood eases.
results.B: Chetzemoka takes slip B. That slip is the lee of the Union Wharf pile.
